quarterly_data.quarter: Murata press release: Murata to Invest Approximately 6.2 Billion Yen in the (09-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Murata Electronics (Thailand), a manufacturing subsidiary, will invest approximately 6.2 billion yen (including the building and production facilities) to construct a new four-story production building for EMI suppression filters on its Lamphun premises, to respond to growing demand by expanding Murata's EMI suppression filter production capacity. Construction starts September 2026 and is expected to be completed in November 2027; total floor area 10,797 square meters.
quarterly_data.figure: approx. 6.2 billion yen; 10,797 square meters; construction September 2026 to November 2027
